jobs_results.title: Prácticas Analista de Negocios (Data Analyst)
jobs_results.description:
Occident, una de las grandes empresas del sector asegurador en nuestra casa, y está emprendiendo, desde su departamento de Data Science, la transformación de la compañía hacia un modelo data-centric.

En este contexto el departamento de Data Science fomenta el desarrollo y la aplicación de modelos de Machine Learning para la resolución de problemas y mejora de procesos de negocio en la compañía.

Dentro de este departamento, estamos buscando la incorporación de un estudiante con interés en el área de Data Science para colaborar con el equipo en un rol de analista de negocios. Este rol consistirá en entender las problemáticas de los equipos de negocio de la compañía para encontrar soluciones tecnológicas, basadas en el uso de datos, que colaboren a la mejora de sus procesos.

Requisitos:

· Se busca una persona con pensamiento crítico y habilidades para la resolución de problemas.

· Persona proactiva, participativa, con capacidad de trabajo en equipo y ganas de aprender dentro de un... área en constante evolución.

· Capacidad de abstracción y conceptualización de conceptos difusos.

· Conocimientos avanzados de estadística/matemáticas

· Conocimientos básicos de programación (Python/R/SQL recomendables)

· Conocimientos básicos de Machine Learning / Deep Learning

Competencias:

· Reflexión y propuesta de ideas para solucionar problemáticas empresariales con el uso de datos y algoritmos de Machine Learning.

· Autonomía para conceptualizar problemas en propuestas de datos concretas de aplicación a negocio.

· Análisis y derivación de información útil en base a los sistemas de datos de la compañía.

· Aplicación y transformación adecuada de la información para alimentar modelos de Machine Learning.

· Evaluación tangible de las soluciones de datos propuestas.

· Interrelación con diferentes departamentos de la compañía.

La oferta incluye:

· Formación en diversos aspectos de Machine Learning.

· Formación en aspectos como "Critical Thinking" o "Problem Solving"

· Jornada 25 h/semana.

· Horario flexible adaptado a las necesidades del estudiante.

· Teletrabajo 3 días semanales.

· Retribución bruta de 10€/h.

· Posibilidad de realizar el TFG/TFM si la colaboración se prolonga más de un semestre.

· Posibilidad de incorporación finalizado el convenio de prácticas

jobs_results.title: Junior Data Analyst con Power BI
jobs_results.description:
Desde Agap2 buscamos incorporar al equipo de Data de uno de nuestros principales clientes un/ una Data Analyst.

Como Analista de Datos, tus funciones principales serán:
• Gestionar, analizar e interpretar bases de datos.
• Elaboración de informes y dashboards para ayudar en la toma de decisiones del negocio.
• Trabajarás en entorno técnico con Power BI y BBDD Oracle.

Valoramos:
• 1-2 años de experienicia como Data Analyst haciendo uso de Power BI.
• Disponibilidad para trabajar presencialmente en las oficinas de cliente (Barcelona).

Trabajar con nosotros te aportará:
• Contratación indefinida desde el primer momento.
• Retribución en función de los conocimientos y experiencia aportados.
• Posición estable con plan de carrera dentro de la empresa.
• Jornada completa y modalida presencial en Barcelona.
• Flexibilidad horaria.
• Formación contínua y acceso a múltiples cursos y certificaciones.
• Participar en proyectos desafiantes en un entorno dinámico.
• Dispondrás de retribución... flexible, ticket restaurant, seguro médico, entre otros beneficios.
• 23 días laborales de vacaciones.

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Location: Spain/Portugal, hybrid or fully remote

Job Summary:

Our Regional Deployment Team is seeking a Healthcare Senior Data Analyst to analyse, map and ingest healthcare data into a data warehouse. The successful candidate will be responsible for deep understanding of clinical data sources and its related healthcare classifications/ontologies from various data sources, map it to target common data models, and ensuring the data is accurate and complete.

Responsibilities:
• Collect, organize, and analyse healthcare data from various sources, including electronic health records, claims data, and other sources.
• Ensure data accuracy and completeness by performing data quality checks and resolving data discrepancies.
• Ingest healthcare data into the data warehouse, ensuring data is properly formatted and optimized for analysis.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including healthcare professionals, IT, data engineers, and architects, to ensure data is properly analysed and... mapped.
• Lead in defining a data governance methodology and applying best practises to ensure that data is properly managed and secured.

Requirements:
• 5+ years of experience in healthcare data analysis, data warehousing, or related field.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex healthcare data sets.
• Familiarity with SQL, and other programming languages for data analysis.
• Experience with data of the medical domain
• General experience with Ontologies and Ontology crosswalks
• Experienced with the data exchange standards such as FHIR and other HL7 standards (v2.x, v3.x).
• Experienced with data governance and processes
• Knowledge of healthcare industry data standards and data models
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
• Comfortable to engage different healthcare professionals such as physicians, nurses, and other clinical professionals.
• Detail-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible – to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst - Energy
jobs_results.description:
Grenergy es un productor independiente de energía (IPP) que integra el desarrollo, construcción, operación y mantenimiento de plantas de energía renovable a gran escala. La compañía incorpora además sus propios equipos dedicados a la originación de PPAs, financiación estructurada y M&A, generando eficiencias como consecuencia de la integración de todo el proceso.

A finales de 2019, dimos el salto a Mercado Continuo (Bolsa de Madrid), consolidando nuestro crecimiento y permitiéndonos continuar con nuestro ambicioso plan de expansión internacional. En la actualidad, contamos con presencia en 12 países: España (HQ), Chile, Colombia, Perú, México, Argentina, Italia, Alemania, Reino Unido, Polonia, Rumanía y Estados Unidos.

Grenergy ya cuenta con cerca de 1GW de proyectos en operación y construcción, y con un pipeline de 10GW de proyectos solares y eólicos en distintas etapas de desarrollo. Además, en 2021, la compañía ha invertido recursos para avanzar en el desarrollo de un pipeline... adicional de casi 5GWh de proyectos de almacenamiento.

Debido a este crecimiento y a la fuerte apuesta de Grenergy, actualmente buscamos incorporar a un/a Data Analyst en nuestro equipo de Asset Management:

Cómo será tu día a día:
• Recolección y análisis de la información técnica de los proyectos.
• Optimización de las bases de datos, mejorando tiempos de gestión y posibilitando una mejor toma de decisiones.
• Mejora permanente en las herramientas de reporting, incorporando las buenas prácticas presentes en el mercado.
• Control y reporte del desempeño técnico-económico de activos fotovoltaicos y eólicos de la Compañía.
• Liderar iniciativas junto al equipo técnico en campo que permitan aumentar la generación de los activos renovables.

Requisitos de la posición:
• Estudios: Ingeniería Eléctrica, Mecánica, Química, Industrial, Minas o afín.
• Al menos 1-2 años de experiencia en un rol similar.
• Deseable experiencia en el sector energético. Al menos experiencia en empresas de productivas a nivel industrial.
• Nivel de inglés B2 o superior.
• Microsoft office avanzado: Excel, Power BI, Power Point.
• Buenas habilidades comunicacionales, proactividad y trabajo en equipo.
• Motivación y pasión por el desarrollo de las energías renovables.
• Deseable Python o similar.

Ofrecemos gran desarrollo profesional y estabilidad en un sector en auge, en una empresa cotizada en pleno crecimiento y expansión internacional, así como buen ambiente en un equipo joven y dinámico.

Grenergy se compromete a ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades laborales, sin discriminación, a todos los empleados y candidatos sin distinción de raza, sexo, edad, ascendencia, color, religión, discapacidad, estado civil, origen, identidad de género, orientación sexual o cualquier otra característica

jobs_results.title: Specialist Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 300 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ 11,000 people and operate in more than 55 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact. What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.”

Specialist Data Analyst Asset Control

Position Purpose
• Create advanced analyses to find opportunities and paint points for Asset Control globally.
•... Automate recurrent analyses ensuring good performance and accuracy on the results.
• Develop machine learning models that help explain business problems.
• Find solutions to business problems using data and advanced analytics algorithms.
• Propose new solutions based on data that could deliver value from asset control point of view.
• Help drive the strategy of the area answering business questions.

Major/Key Accountabilities
• Partner with business teams to support strategic initiatives & projects using data as main enabler.
• Develop and deploy analysis as per asset control requirements.
• Work closely with all internal stakeholders to improve the quality of insights provided.
• Translate analytics requirements into actionable user-friendly outputs.
• Ensure best practices implementation to improve service to business stakeholders.
• Ensure insights are available to be used on internal processes.
• Propose enhancements on new/current tools (standardization, usability, workload).
• Create internal documentation about internal processes.
• Investigate and propose external data sources that can bring value for asset control processes.
• Define new analytical methodologies to solve business problems.
• Use machine learning algorithms to find opportunities.
• Find solutions to complex business problems using data.
• Lead the analytical approach with state-of-the-art technical solutions.
• Define analytical best practices.
• Use advanced analytics to be able to predict future opportunities for Asset Control
• Cover analyses regarding all programs and regions Asset Productivity covers.
• Help drive the strategy of the area answering business questions.

Measures
• Deployment of the analytic processes as per plan.
• Ensure analytics created cover business needs and provide value to stakeholders.
• Ensure analytics are delivered on a timely manner.
• Customer satisfaction.

Qualifications
• Minimum of 4 years working experience in a similar role.

Experience
• Strong python skills applied to analysis.
• Experience working with complex coding frameworks.
• Experience in finding business opportunities.
• Knowledge on cloud computing environments.
• Ability to write, improve and troubleshoot SQL queries.
• Experience working in Python or R to perform data analysis.
• Ability to analyse, model and interpret data.
• Analytical background and expertise in transforming data into insights.
• Comfortable presenting insights and interacting with senior management and explain complex ideas simply.
• Experience designing visual presentations to tell the story behind the data.
• Previous business analytics experience.
• Experience understanding complex data patterns.
• Experience applying machine learning to solve business problems.
• Worked with measures and KPIs.
• Working on remote teams.
• Proved experience organizing own tasks (manage priorities, standardization, automation, troubleshooting and short-term planning).

Skills and Knowledge
• Strong service orientation.
• Very autonomous and capable to lead projects.
• Very strong analytic skills.
• Business oriented.
• Accountability
• Very good customer orientated communication skills.
• Diplomatic and sensitive when serving customers of a different mentality and culture.
• Can act under time pressure and interact with senior level stakeholders.
• Ability to work with remote teams.
• Driven by results.
• Ability to learn on the fly.
• Problem solver (troubleshooting).
• Accuracy and attention to detail.

Languages

Essential

English

Desirable

Spanish

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
At WeDoData, our client who is a forward-thinking organization committed to harnessing the power of data to drive informed decision-making and business growth. We're seeking a talented Sr. Data Analyst who is passionate about transforming complex data into actionable insights. As a key member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge tools and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation and success.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our team and play a pivotal role in transforming data into meaningful insights. The ideal candidate will be proficient in data visualization techniques, adept at creating interactive dashboards, and experienced in SQL query optimization. If you're someone who thrives on delivering strategic insights and enjoys collaborating with stakeholders to drive business goals, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:
• Implement best practices for data visualization, ensuring... clarity, accuracy, and accessibility for a diverse audience.
• Develop and maintain interactive, user-friendly dashboards using tools such as Tableau, or Power BI.
• Provide actionable and strategic insights derived from data analysis to support decision-making processes.
• Write and optimize SQL queries to efficiently extract and manipulate data from databases.
• Utilize Azure cloud services for data storage, processing, and analysis.
• Conduct thorough testing of visualizations to ensure accuracy, completeness, and responsiveness.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to define and establish key performance indicators (KPIs) relevant to data analysis goals.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field.
• Proven experience in data analysis and visualization, with proficiency in tools like Tableau, or Power BI.
• Strong SQL skills with experience in query optimization.
• Strong with Azure cloud services for data storage and analysis.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for detail.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
• Prior experience in defining and establishing key performance indicators (KPIs) is a plus.

Benefits:
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Opportunities for professional development and growth.
• Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
• Flexible work arrangements.
• Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and tools.

How to Apply:

If you're passionate about transforming data into actionable insights and thrive in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and detail why you're a great fit for this role to tansy@wedodata.es

At WeDoData, our client who is a forward-thinking organization committed to harnessing the power of data to drive informed decision-making and business growth. We're seeking a talented Sr. Data Analyst who is passionate about transforming complex data into actionable insights. As a key member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge tools and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation and success.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our team and play a pivotal role in transforming data into meaningful insights. The ideal candidate will be proficient in data visualization techniques, adept at creating interactive dashboards, and experienced in SQL query optimization. If you're someone who thrives on delivering strategic insights and enjoys collaborating with stakeholders to drive business goals, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:
• Implement best practices for data visualization, ensuring... clarity, accuracy, and accessibility for a diverse audience.
• Develop and maintain interactive, user-friendly dashboards using tools such as Tableau, or Power BI.
• Provide actionable and strategic insights derived from data analysis to support decision-making processes.
• Write and optimize SQL queries to efficiently extract and manipulate data from databases.
• Utilize Azure cloud services for data storage, processing, and analysis.
• Conduct thorough testing of visualizations to ensure accuracy, completeness, and responsiveness.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to define and establish key performance indicators (KPIs) relevant to data analysis goals.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field.
• Proven experience in data analysis and visualization, with proficiency in tools like Tableau, or Power BI.
• Strong SQL skills with experience in query optimization.
• Strong with Azure cloud services for data storage and analysis.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for detail.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
• Prior experience in defining and establishing key performance indicators (KPIs) is a plus.

Benefits:
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Opportunities for professional development and growth.
• Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
• Flexible work arrangements.
• Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and tools.

How to Apply:

If you're passionate about transforming data into actionable insights and thrive in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and detail why you're a great fit for this role to tansy@wedodata.es

jobs_results.title: Senior Data & Analytics Consultant
jobs_results.description:
About Incubeta

Incubeta is a digital marketing consultancy with a focus on technology, data, and people. Our specialists build solutions that embrace the power of technology, the truth of data, and a spark of human creativity. We help advertisers, agencies, and publishers get the most from digital for their business.

As Google’s most experienced EMEA Sales Partner we have overseen hundreds of deployments across the Google Marketing Platform. We address ad tech infrastructure, data management, integration, and media management and provide clients with relevant and up-to-date digital marketing services and consultancy.

Established in 2001, with 22 offices in 18 countries, we are part of the Incubeta group. A global partnership of leading digital technology, media, and creative specialists. Together, we are experts in end-to-end digital advertising services and media solutions.

The Position

Are you the Data & Analytics rockstar we are looking for? Join our team in Madrid and help us... to grow the analytics service by revolutionizing digital analytics within the Southern Europe market!

We are looking for an experienced Data & Analytics Consultant who will provide detailed solutions to achieve maximum conversion and increase turnover for the business.

As part of the Data & Analytics team, you actively participate in the projects carried out by Incubeta. These projects cover a wide range of services, including data collection, data analysis, dashboarding, CRO, and Cloud 4 Marketing projects. You will also actively participate in the Data & Analytics offers.

Reporting to the Consulting Manager, you will help prioritize web analytics requests, tasks & deliverables according to business needs across different Industries. This is an exciting time to join as our Data and Analytics team is going through a big period of growth.

Role and Responsibilities
• Lead the promotion of Data / Analytics Marketing maturity framework to our clients
• Ensure the quality of deliverables sent to the client. (Analysis, presentations, etc..)
• Follow a structured action plan punctuated by various milestones.
• Ensure data quality & accuracy.
• Oversee operational and technical implementation with junior profiles or data engineers / data scientists
• Address issues related to digital activity management using key performance indicators.
• Guide clients in optimizing website conversion through analysis and optimization of online media purchasing.
• Provide data analysis services for clients, focusing on industry-specific indicators in areas such as travel, telco, retail, financial services etc.. to ensure alignment with their business objectives.

Your character
• A minimum of 2 years of experience in Data / Analytics Marketing or digital marketing within a consulting firm (strategy, organization, IT, etc.), a Business Intelligence solutions provider, or directly with the advertiser.
• Business acumen
• You are passionate about technology and how it can shape the online advertising industry & ecosystem to the benefit of our customers,
• You feel comfortable communicating both internally and with our customers
• Proven expertise in online acquisition channels: search engines (SEO, SEM, bid-management tools), display ads, email marketing, social media, AdExchange, mobile apps, and more.
• Analytical mindset, coupled with exceptional written and oral communication skills.
• You have a proactive & cooperative approach to problem-solving,
• You are able to translate customer needs and deliver a high level of customer satisfaction,
• You are able to work independently whilst being able to work in a diverse cross-functional team,
• You are autonomous in your work and projects,
• You have a knack for finding innovative solutions,
• You want to keep learning and developing your expertise

Your profile
• Minimum 2 - 3 years experience working on digital analytics projects, especially Google Analytics (Universal Analytics and GA4).
• University Degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, or Marketing.
• Fluent in Spanish and good knowledge of business English (Portuguese & Italian are a plus)
• Sound understanding of the Southern European and specific Spanish online advertising industry - knowledge of the underlying technology, major tech providers, agencies landscape, and online media buying & selling processes including the programmatic buying landscape,
• Ability to code/script in support of customer requirements (SQL and/or Javascript and/or Python)
• Experience in designing and building solutions with ETL, TMS, Web Analytics tools, etc.
• Strong in strategic analysis and profound advisory skills,
• Proven track record of successful business development gained at a media agency or advertiser level,
• Proven expert knowledge in Google Analytics 360,
• Strong understanding of all digital marketing channels, ad technologies, cross-media solutions,
• Advanced project management skills,
• Knowledge of Analysis techniques applied to Marketing. Google Cloud knowledge is a plus.

Benefits of working with us
• Working with exciting clients and worldwide enterprise companies alike
• Multilingual and multicultural teamwork
• Freedom to be authentic
• Ownership and accountability for all your projects
• Awesome colleagues & awesome clients
• An international, fast-paced job with attractive professional development opportunities
• Opportunity to grow in a startup environment

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Make is the leading visual platform for anyone to design, build, and automate anything—from tasks and workflows to apps and systems—without the need for coding skills. We are headquartered in the flourishing tech hub of Prague, Czech Republic, and our teams are spread across the USA, UK, Germany, France, Canada, India and Chile, among other locations.

We are seeking a highly motivated Sales Analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will be a great communicator and collaborator, with a passion for using data and insights to drive action. The role will continue to build our data-driven approach to Go To Market & Sales through efforts including: clear, insightful reporting, proactive identification of new opportunities, and closely monitoring and evaluating performance.

Responsibilities:

You will be the primary data and analytics business partner to the Sales and Go To Market teams, working closely with the group to understand and identify needs. In this roles you will:
•... Development of pre-sales and post-sales intelligence, including dashboards, reports and insights.
• Proactively interpret data to provide insights and identify areas for improvement
• Provide data and ad-hoc analyses to the sales team and management as needed
• Cooperate with our Go To Market Operations team in facilitating and driving regular cadencies (reviews of Pipeline, QBRs, Targets etc.) as well as improving overall sales funnel intelligence
• Work with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement and drive critical thinking to challenge the status quo

What we are looking for:
• Fluent in English with great collaboration and communication skills to work with others across the business to turn data to insights to drive action
• A proactive approach and genuine curiosity to understand and share what the data means.
• Good technical skills and experience, comfortable with spreadsheet analysis, SQL code, and building dashboards.
• Eager to use new technologies, tackle new challenges, flourish in a fast-paced environment and contribute to our data-driven culture.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in Data / Business Analytics / Sales Operations / Consulting
• A plus if you have experience with:
• Sales, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market processes and metrics (i.e ARR, Churn, ACV, Revenue and Pipeline Conversion Rates, etc) a plus
• Understanding of the typical SaaS customer lifecycle journey from acquisition to retention and expansion a plus
• CRM tools and their Databases (like Salesforce, SAP or Pipedrive) and Customer care tools (like FreshDesk, Custify etc.)

What we offer:
• 📈 RSUs grant in a rapidly growing company raising its value every day
• 💸 Annual bonus
• 🌎 Multinational team with 42 nationalities creating the future of automation
• 🎓 Learning & Development plan (online language, professional courses, conference tickets and other trainings) & 2 Company Learning Days per year
• 🌳3 Company Impact Days per year
• 🍎 Notebook/Macbook and 34’’ curved monitor
• 🏝 25 days of vacation, 4 sick days, company day off on 31st December
• 🫶 10 care days to care for your loved ones
• 👨👩👧👦 Extra parental vacation (3-6 months)
• 👶 RSUs grant for a newborn child
• ☂️ Life insurance
• 🏋️ Gympass
• 💳 Meal and transportation tickets, medical insurance
• 🥳 Team buildings, parties, and company events multiple times a year
• 🏡 Flexible working hours + home office

If you are a numbers person passionate about creating data-driven insights and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply for this role.

Join us on the ride!

#careeratmake

What we stand for:

🤝 We roll together - We embrace different ideas to grow together and create powerful solutions.

🚀 Customer impact first - We empower our customers to succeed, aiming for sustainable impact.

⚽ Game on! - We're explorers at heart: play is our fuel and creativity has no limits.

For more, feel free to check out our Life at Make Instagram, Meet-up page, or YouTube to get a sense of the vibe.

Make is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. We will not tolerate any unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind. We make all employment decisions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, sex, pregnancy, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, transgender status, national origin, citizenship status, religion, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable anti-discrimination laws. As a US federal contractor, we are committed to the principles of affirmative action in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Different makes us better.

Accessibility and Candidate Notices

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics
jobs_results.description:
This role is hybrid (2 days per week) in our Barcelona office

Who we're looking for:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Operations Analyst at Rover who is excited about independently owning complex, cross-functional projects from end to end. You will partner with senior business leaders on high visibility projects, relentlessly pursuing outcomes that directly influence the customer experience on the Rover platform. You will be seen as a thought leader on the team and across the organization, and should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in identifying and solving business problems.

We want someone who is passionate about directly shaping Rover’s support experience. You should be excited about partnering with product and business leaders to identify problems in the support experience and generate solutions that scale with the business. You will be responsible for designing robust tests and sophisticated analyses that deliver strong, actionable... recommendations to improve our business. Examples of this include developing our strategy for multi-language global support, improving our self serve support experience, optimizing agent processes and workflows, assessing and improving how we measure support quality, etc.

In addition to concurrently driving several high impact cross functional projects, this person will also be responsible for creating new metrics to understand the performance of new business initiatives, developing reporting dashboards, and building data abstractions in DBT. Additionally, they will play a vital role in supporting AB testing and experimentation efforts, using statistical analysis to evaluate changes and drive meaningful change across the business.

Your Responsibilities:
• Partner with business leaders to identify and size problem areas, conduct deep and comprehensive analyses to better understand the problem and recommend solutions.
• Partner with our Operations Scalability product team to find opportunities to improve our customer experience and reduce our support costs through improving agent efficiency
• Develop strategies to both measure and optimize the organization’s efficiency, agent performance, and interactions with customers
• Serve as strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, responsible for making recommendations on investments and optimization strategies in key functional area
• Help build the team by mentoring junior team members on data manipulation and business partnering
• Support the construction of our reporting abstractions (built in dbt)

Your Qualifications:
• At least 6 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
• You are extremely comfortable with taking ambiguous issues and structuring them into crisp business problems, and using those to develop and execute on a refined project plan with clearly identified deliverables, all with relative autonomy.
• Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists
• You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
• You can independently prioritize projects based on return on investment and own the end-to-end project management for our analytics deliverables
• You are excited to help build a team and mentor junior analysts

Nice to have:
• Masters degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
• Ability to code in Python/R is a plus
• Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
• Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design

Benefits of working at Rover:
• Competitive compensation
• Permanent contract
• Pension Plan
• Meal tickets through Cobee
• Generous PTO Allowance
• Private health insurance
• Discounted Gym Membership
• Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
• Monetary help for adopting a dog plus yearly credit to use on our platform
• Flexible work hours, sometimes you’ll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we’re pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
• Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
• Regular team activities, including happy hours, game nights, and more

Who we are:

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

We believe everyone deserves the unconditional love of a pet—and at Rover, our mission is to make it easier to experience that love. Founded in 2011, the Rover app and website connect dog and cat parents with loving pet sitters and dog walkers in neighborhoods across the US, Canada, and Europe. We empower our community of trusted pet sitters and dog walkers to run their own pet care businesses on Rover with the tools and security of a global company to back them.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, we work closely with our teams in Barcelona, San Antonio, Spokane, and remote locations. We’ve got a reputation for being a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. We're an agile, fast-growing company, and our leadership comes from some of the world's most respected tech companies.

At Rover, our furry coworkers are just as important as our human ones—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. Along with making the joys of pet parenthood more accessible, we’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming community of pet people—and that starts with our employees

Founded in 2011, the Rover app and website connect dog and cat parents with loving pet sitters and dog walkers in neighborhoods across the US, Canada, and Europe. We empower our community of trusted pet sitters and dog walkers to run their own pet care businesses on Rover with the tools and security of a global company to back them.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, we work closely with our teams in Barcelona, San Antonio, Spokane, and remote locations. We’ve got a reputation for being a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. We're an agile, fast-growing company, and our leadership comes from some of the world's most respected tech companies.

At Rover, our furry coworkers are just as important as our human ones—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. Along with making the joys of pet parenthood more accessible, we’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming community of pet people—and that starts with our employees
